stem: A pharmacist wonders whether Belsomra dispensing is omitted from MassPAT because it is not a benzodiazepine. What is correct?

choices.text: Use the out-of-state prescription rule when its schedule, age, and verification conditions have not been checked.
Report it because Schedule IV status, not benzodiazepine class alone, brings covered dispensing into MassPAT.
Process another refill because an authorization written by the prescriber overrides schedule limits.
Treat the request as an insufficient-stock partial fill and use the 72-hour remainder rule.
Handle the drug or transaction as ordinary Massachusetts Schedule VI activity.

explanation.core_reasoning: Covered pharmacies report dispensing of Schedule II through V controlled substances and DPH-designated additional drugs, including gabapentin, to the Massachusetts PMP under the current submission standard. suvorexant (Belsomra) is used for treatment of insomnia with sleep-onset or sleep-maintenance difficulty. It is federal Schedule IV and Massachusetts Schedule IV; its legal consequence in this scenario follows the cited schedule-specific rule.
